description: This file defines the CustomerAPI class, which provides REST API endpoints for managing Customer entities within the OrangeHRM Time plugin. It includes methods for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting customers, along with input validation rules and API documentation annotations.

classes.name: CustomerAPI
classes.description: API class for handling CRUD operations related to Customer entities in the OrangeHRM Time module, with validation and documentation annotations.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all customer records with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new customer record based on input parameters.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes customers with specified IDs, handling exceptions if customer has logged time.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific customer by ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing customer record identified by ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the 'getAll' API method.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for creating a customer.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rules for deleting customers.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Validation rules for retrieving a single customer.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Validation rules for updating a customer.

methods.name: getCommonBodyValidationRules
methods.description: Helper method to generate validation rules for request body parameters.

methods.name: getNameCommonUniqueOption
methods.description: Creates an option object for validating unique customer names, ignoring specific values.

methods.name: setParamsToCustomer
methods.description: Populates a Customer entity with data from request parameters.
